purpose: Lightweight system-wide CPU usage sampler via kernel32 GetSystemTimes; no PerformanceCounter or admin rights required.
calls_out_to: kernel32!GetSystemTimes — reads system idle/kernel/user time FILETIME counters
invariants: First call always returns false (seeds baseline; no delta yet)
percent is clamped to 100 if arithmetic overflows
Returns false if GetSystemTimes fails or total time delta is zero
gotchas: kernelTime includes idle time — busy = total - idle, not kernelTime alone; this is correct Windows behavior
Not thread-safe; designed for single-threaded use from the 5-second polling timer in TrayAppContext
